headlines.title: Raised Outlooks and a Cancer Approval Arrive in the Middle of Medicare Open Enrollment
headlines.summary: Market Updates News Commentary - Health care stocks moved higher with the broader market on Monday morning. As of 9:58 a.m. ET, the State Street Health Care Select Sector SPDR ETF was up 0.88% at $186.42, while the S&P 500 was up 1.70% at 7,501.96. Medicare Open Enrollment is underway, and over the past week companies in pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, health insurance, medical devices and drug distribution have reported quarterly results or regulatory news.

headlines.title: What Is Johnson & Johnson (JNJ) Signaling With Two Key Trial Wins?
headlines.summary: Johnson & Johnson (NYSE: JNJ) reported positive Phase 1 results for a dual-antigen immunotherapy in metastatic prostate cancer, including a strong PSA response and clean safety profile. The pasritamig and JNJ-9401 combination is now advancing to Phase 3 testing in men with advanced disease. Separately, oral ICOTYDE (icotrokinra) delivered significant joint and skin symptom improvements in biologic naive psoriatic arthritis patients in a Phase 3 trial.

headlines.title: J&J Backs Psychedelic-Inspired Biotech in $100 Million Round
headlines.summary: Johnson & Johnson is backing a biotech company developing psychedelic-inspired medicines that promise to treat depression without the hallucinations, leading a $100 million financing round as pharmaceutical companies increasingly embrace a once-fringe field.

headlines.title: Johnson & Johnson’s ICOTYDE Meets Primary Endpoint in Phase 3 Psoriatic Arthritis Trial
headlines.summary: Johnson & Johnson (NYSE:JNJ) announced that its investigational treatment ICOTYDE (icotrokinra) achieved the primary endpoint in a Phase 3 clinical trial involving adults with active psoriatic arthritis who had not previously received biologic therapies. The ICONIC-PsA 1 study evaluated the efficacy and safety of ICOTYDE at a dose of 200 mg administered once daily.

description: Johnson & Johnson, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research and development, manufacture, and sale of a range of products in the healthcare field worldwide. It operates in two segments, Innovative Medicine and MedTech. The Innovative Medicine segment offers products for various therapeutic areas, such as oncology, immunology, neuroscience, pulmonary hypertension, infectious diseases, and cardiovascular and metabolism distributed through retailers, wholesalers, distributors, hospitals, and healthcare professionals for prescription use. The MedTech segment provides a portfolio of products used in the surgery, orthopedic, cardiovascular, and vision fields distributed through wholesalers, hospitals and retailers, and used in the professional fields by physicians, nurses, hospitals, eye care professionals and clinics. This segment also offers products and enabling technologies that support joint reconstruction, trauma, spine, sports related injuries, and others, as well as open, laparoscopic, and robotic surgical procedures; instrumentation, energy devices, stapling systems, wound closure, biosurgery products, and digital and robotic technologies; breast aesthetics and reconstruction; contact lenses under the ACUVUE brand; intraocular lenses for cataract surgery, and other products used in cataract and refractive procedures under the TECNIS brand. The company was founded in 1886 and is based in New Brunswick, New Jersey.
